description: Source code for Odoo module related to report analytic planning, defining models, database views, and calculations for planning and analysis.

classes.name: report_account_analytic.planning
classes.description: Model representing a planning with associated lines and statistics.

classes.name: report_account_analytic.planning.line
classes.description: Model representing individual planning lines linked to analytic accounts and users.

classes.name: report_account_analytic.planning.stat.account
classes.description: View model for planning account statistics, including real hours from analytic lines.

classes.name: report_account_analytic.planning.stat
classes.description: View model for planning statistics per user and account, including task hours and timesheet data.

classes.name: report_account_analytic.planning.stat.user
classes.description: View model for user-specific planning statistics, including timesheet hours.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of a planning record with cleared statistics.

methods.name: _sum_amount_real
methods.description: Calculates total hours from analytic lines for a given account or user.

methods.name: _sum_amount_tasks
methods.description: Calculates total planned task hours within the planning period.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes database views for statistical reporting.
